messages:
maria: Heads-up: drafting release notes for 2.7.1. Need final PR list, pin matrix, and canary window. Target deploy 2026-03-24 23:00 UTC. +cc @oncall-liz

sam: I'll finish changelog bullets by EOD. Paste PRs you want highlighted?

kevin: pushed perf fix PR #3245. Suggest blurb: 'perf: reduce KV cache thrash on long seqs' :thumbsup:

maria: Added PRs to the doc: #3245 (perf), #3238 (docs), #3251 (rollback guard). Draft RN below 
```
Release 2.7.1 (internal)
- Serving runtime: prefer fused-attention kernels for xformers-compatible models (approx -7% token latency)
- Batching: transient batch cutoff to avoid tail latency spikes
- Safety: rollback guard to clear stale model pins after failed canary
- Ops: new deploy flag `--pin-model=redwood-open-7b-v2-q4` for canary
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window set: 2026-03-24T23:00Z -> prod-blue. Canary: 5% for 15m, then 50% for 30m. Rollback triggers: error rate >3% or p95 latency >800ms.

julie: For internal announce, propose two bullets: what changed + engineer action (verify pins). I'll draft a short blurb.

sam: One ask: confirm fallback pin includes previous stable `redwood-open-7b-v1` so services with pinned overrides don't blow up. Kevin?

kevin: Confirmed: fallback to v1 compatible variant. Also note quantized variant `redwood-open-7b-v1-q4` exists.

oncall-liz: I'll be oncall for the window. If deploy-bot flips to rollback, ping #eng-oncall and I'll run the rollback playbook. Set PD escalation to oncall-liz.

maria: Updated RN in /docs/internal/rn-2.7.1.md. Julie 12 can you turn this into the internal announcement copy? I'll attach pin matrix and PR list.

julie: Draft internal announcement: "Deploying 2.7.1 tonight 23:00 UTC 00 12 low-risk perf & safety fixes. Canary 5% for 15m -> 50% for 30m. Action: If your service pins models, verify compatibility or update pinned fallback by 20:00 UTC. Link: <internal doc>"

sam: LGTM. Add rollback note: "Ops will revert to `redwood-open-7b-v1` on triggered rollback. If you have custom pins, update by 20:00 UTC."

deploy-bot: To schedule via CLI: `/deploy release 2.7.1 --canary 5% --canary-duration 15m --pin redwood-open-7b-v2-q4`

maria: I'll run schedule command in ~10m to validate job and will post final announce snippet here when done.

deploy-bot: Deploy job created (job id d-20260324-2310). ETA trigger 2026-03-24T23:00Z.

sam: Thanks. Julie will post internal announce at 21:30 UTC. @oncall-liz please watch the canary and escalate if thresholds hit.

maria: Final: include quick rollback steps (link to runbook) and pinned fallback list in announcement. I'll add a one-line table to the RN.
file_review_notes: Focused thread: release notes drafting, PR highlights, model pin matrix, deploy-bot scheduling, rollback thresholds, internal announcement copy. Realistic Slack style: short messages, inline code, deploy-bot responses, oncall coordination.
